ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels in distal lobe regions and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central zone and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions on distal lobes. Left lobe exhibits dense, speckled low-intensity mottling. Right lobe features a large low-intensity smudge bordering the median notch and discrete circular low-intensity spots localized near the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees; indentation depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular sawtooth boundary across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 5 to 15 pixels, with the highest frequency of peaks located on the outer-third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the upper boundaries of both lobes, terminating in acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-contrast, three-dimensional structures (barnacles) on the far-left leading edge tip. Single distinct high-intensity circular pixel cluster on the far-right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical low-intensity linear disruption on the left lobe's white field; multiple diagonal low-intensity linear marks on the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Biological encrustation (barnacle colony) on the left leading edge; distinct circular dark indentation on the far-right distal margin.
